judul: Mosi Integral Natsir dan Rekayasa Konstitusional Menuju Negara Kesatuan 1950
judul_en: Mohammad Natsir's Integral Motion of 1950: Constitutional Liquidation of the RIS Federal States
deskripsi: Bedah arsitektur hukum di balik Mosi Integral Mohammad Natsir 3 April 1950: mekanisme Pasal 43–44 Konstitusi RIS 1949, Piagam Persetujuan 19 Mei 1950, UU Federal Nomor 7 Tahun 1950, hingga berlakunya UUDS 1950.
deskripsi_en: Juridical-historical examination of Mohammad Natsir's 3 April 1950 Integral Motion: Articles 43–44 of the 1949 RIS Constitution, the 19 May 1950 Agreement Charter, and Federal Law No. 7 of 1950.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Penolakan di Pejambon: Silang Pendapat Yamin dan Soepomo soal Uji Materiil 1945
judul_en: Pejambon Debates 1945: Yamin vs. Soepomo on Constitutional Judicial Review
deskripsi: Menelusuri perdebatan Muhammad Yamin dan Soepomo dalam Sidang BPUPKI Juli 1945 mengenai hak uji materiil, dampaknya pada Pasal 24 UUD 1945 dan periode 1949–1950, hingga pembaruan Pasal 24C UUD 1945.
deskripsi_en: Tracing the July 1945 BPUPKI clash between Muhammad Yamin and Soepomo over judicial review through Article 24 of 1945 to Article 24C and Constitutional Court Law No. 24/2003.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Kedaulatan Data Nasabah menurut UU PDP No. 27/2022 & Arsitektur AI On-Premise Perbankan
judul_en: Client Data Sovereignty under Indonesia's PDP Law No. 27/2022 & On-Premise Banking AI
deskripsi: Kajian regulasi dan arsitektur Small Language Models (SLMs) on-premise di sektor perbankan: jaminan kedaulatan data nasabah menurut UU PDP No. 27/2022, batasan transfer data, serta kepatuhan Panduan Tata Kelola AI OJK.
deskripsi_en: Regulatory and architectural study of on-premise Small Language Models (SLMs) in banking: client data sovereignty under Law No. 27/2022 (UU PDP) and OJK AI governance compliance.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Akuntabilitas Algoritmik, Mitigasi Bias Kerja, dan Kepatuhan UU PDP dalam Sistem HR Berbasis AI
judul_en: Algorithmic Accountability, Employment Bias Mitigation & PDP Law Compliance in AI Talent Systems
deskripsi: Evaluasi hukum dan etika pemanfaatan sistem seleksi otomatis dalam HR: audit bias algoritmik, hak subjek data atas pemrofilan menurut UU PDP No. 27/2022, serta doktrin kendali manusia SE Menkominfo No. 9/2023.
deskripsi_en: Legal and ethical assessment of automated hiring tools: disparate-impact audits, subject rights over automated profiling under UU PDP No. 27/2022, and human oversight doctrine.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Kepatuhan Eksekutif di Hadapan Palu Hakim dan Batas Diskresi Birokrasi
judul_en: Executive Obedience to Judicial Rulings and the Legal Limits of Bureaucratic Discretion
deskripsi: Telaah kewajiban pejabat pemerintahan mematuhi putusan pengadilan dalam negara hukum berdasarkan UUD 1945, hukum administrasi pemerintahan, dan kewenangan eksekusi PTUN.
deskripsi_en: Constitutional and administrative analysis of public officials' obligation to comply with binding court rulings under the Indonesian rule-of-law framework.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Batas Dua Pertiga di Bandung: Anatomi Kebuntuan Pasal 137 UUDS 1950
judul_en: The Two-Thirds Threshold in Bandung: Anatomy of the Article 137 UUDS 1950 Deadlock
deskripsi: Analisis mekanisme kuorum 2/3 dalam Pasal 137 ayat (1) dan (2) UUDS 1950 di Majelis Konstituante Bandung Mei–Juni 1959 beserta implikasi ketatanegaraan Dekret Presiden 5 Juli 1959.
deskripsi_en: Constitutional study of the two-thirds quorum requirement under Article 137 UUDS 1950 during the May–June 1959 Bandung sessions and the 5 July 1959 Presidential Decree.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Transformasi Lanskap Kecerdasan Artifisial: Paradoks Produktivitas & Tata Kelola Regulasi SE Menkominfo 9/2023
judul_en: AI Landscape Transformation: Productivity Paradox & Governance under SE Menkominfo 9/2023
deskripsi: Kajian mengenai kesenjangan adopsi teknologi AI, doktrin Human-in-the-Loop SE Menkominfo No. 9/2023, perlindungan martabat manusia, serta tata kelola operasional.
deskripsi_en: Scholarly analysis of institutional AI adoption, the mandatory human-in-the-loop doctrine of SE Menkominfo No. 9/2023, human dignity safeguards, and operational governance.
author: Khohar Muhamad Fatahurrohman

judul: Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Tata Kelola Control Plane RBAC dalam Arsitektur Multi-Agent
judul_en: Model Context Protocol (MCP) & RBAC Control Plane Governance in Multi-Agent Architecture
deskripsi: Panduan standar integrasi konteks MCP, pengamanan akses basis data terhadap injeksi instruksi, lapisan kendali Control Plane RBAC, dan audit kepatuhan regulasi AI.
deskripsi_en: Architectural specification for MCP context integration, eliminating raw SQL injection risk, Control Plane RBAC enforcement, and regulatory auditability.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Prinsip Least Agency Privilege & Batas Notifikasi 3x24 Jam UU PDP dalam SOC Berbasis AI
judul_en: Least Agency Privilege & the 72-Hour PDP Law Notification Rule in Autonomous SOC Operations
deskripsi: Kajian keamanan siber SOC: penyaringan alert fatigue SIEM/EDR, pembatasan hak otonom sistem (Least Agency Privilege), dan pemenuhan tenggat pelaporan insiden 3x24 jam UU PDP No. 27/2022.
deskripsi_en: Security and compliance study covering alert triage, Least Agency Privilege boundaries, and mandatory 72-hour breach reporting under Law No. 27/2022.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Tata Kelola Proporsional & Mitigasi Risiko Otomasi dalam Manajemen Rantai Pasok
judul_en: Proportional Governance & Automation Risk Mitigation in Supply Chain Operations
deskripsi: Penerapan piramida tata kelola proporsional dan mitigasi distorsi sistem multi-agen pada logistik dan rantai pasok.
deskripsi_en: Application of proportional governance tiers and consensus controls to prevent systemic distortion in supply chain automation.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Tata Kelola Verifikasi & Eliminasi Governance Debt pada Agen Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak
judul_en: Verification-First Workflows & Mitigating Governance Debt in Automated Software Engineering
deskripsi: Evaluasi standar SWE-bench, alur kerja verification-first, serta penanggulangan governance debt dalam pengembangan sistem perangkat lunak.
deskripsi_en: Evaluation of SWE-bench validation standards, verification-first engineering protocols, and governance debt mitigation in software delivery.
author: Khohar Rohman
